run: RB12-TS-TWINS-1 hand-mutation gate (scratchpad vite-free harness: each mutant is one exact text substitution applied to the file, the narrow tests run with --bail, the file is restored; never committed). 207 mutants over strictbrotli.ts, arbposted/{zeroheavy,derive,nitro,delayed,verify,pins}.ts and baseposted/channel.ts: 184 killed, 23 equivalent, 0 unexplained. Control runs of the unmutated tree (all eight test groups and the 403-test union) were green before the gate. Pass 1 (tier A: the unit files of each package): 155 killed, 52 survived; the survivors were triaged: 29 were killed by tests added for them (units_derive2.test.ts: field order with distinct addresses, an address holding a zero byte, uint64 boundaries, a decoded blob transaction, the nested length boundary, a block holding a prefix of the derivation, the container binding judged before pins and body; 8 more Go-judged answers in strictbrotli_go_judged.json (crafted metablock streams with the failure after the 1st/2nd/3rd 32 KiB read boundary, flips and cuts); the reason and channel-message tests of strictbrotli.test.ts), the rest are listed below. Mutants whose effect is an endless loop are killed by a timeout of the test process.

equivalents.mutant: Number(max + 1n > NODE_MAX_LENGTH ? NODE_MAX_LENGTH : max + 1n) -> Number(max + 1n > NODE_MAX_LENGTH ? NODE_MAX_LENGTH : max + 2n)
equivalents.reason: node's output cap is only a bound on what node allocates: the verdict is taken from the length of the output against max, so a cap of max + 2 yields the same exceeded / not exceeded for every stream (an output of max + 1 passes node's cap and is then exceeded by the length test)

equivalents.mutant: max + 1n > NODE_MAX_LENGTH ? -> max + 1n >= NODE_MAX_LENGTH ?
equivalents.reason: at max + 1 == the largest Buffer both branches yield the same cap

equivalents.mutant: const size = max < 64n ? 64 : Number(max); -> const size = max <= 64n ? 64 : Number(max);
equivalents.reason: at max == 64 both forms give an output buffer of 64 bytes

equivalents.mutant: const size = max < 64n ? 64 : Number(max); -> const size = max < 63n ? 64 : Number(max);
equivalents.reason: differs only at max == 63, where the original probe already lies inside the documented limit of the double-fault emulation (caps below 512, FINDING in checkins/RB12-TS-TWINS-1.md): no Go-judged case at that cap reproduces Go's verdict with either form, so no test can tell them apart in the claimed range

equivalents.mutant: const limit = max < 64n ? 1 : size - 1; -> const limit = max < 64n ? 2 : size - 1;
equivalents.reason: any maxOutputLength below the 64-byte output buffer is exceeded exactly when one full buffer was produced: 1 and 2 behave alike

equivalents.mutant: const limit = max < 64n ? 1 : size - 1; -> const limit = max < 64n ? 1 : size - 2;
equivalents.reason: any maxOutputLength below the output buffer size is exceeded exactly when one full buffer was produced: size - 1 and size - 2 behave alike
